meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会扫描你的代码库,按 9 个维度排查技术债,每条问题都标注 file:line:col、严重级别(Critical/High/Medium/Low)和工时估算,最终写出仓库根目录的 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,内含前 5 项优先修复、快速修复清单和「看似有问题其实没问题」小节。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计或架构评审,或提到「tech debt」「code health」等关键词时触发。

say.text: 对我的代码库做一次技术债审计
say.note: 会在仓库根目录生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md

say.text: 检查代码健康度,按严重程度列出问题
say.note: 每条问题都带 file:line:col 引用

say.text: 给我 30 分钟内能修完的快速修复清单
say.note: 输出 Quick Wins 小节

howto.what_en: Claude audits your codebase across 9 debt dimensions with AST-grep, grep, LSP and native tools, citing file:line:col for every finding. It writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, hour estimates, a Top 5 priority list and quick wins.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, or architecture review, or mention terms like 'tech debt' and 'code health'.

say_en.text: Run a tech debt audit on my codebase
say_en.note: Writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md in the repo root

say_en.text: Check code health and list issues by severity
Give me the quick wins fixable in under 30 minutes
say_en.note: Outputs the Quick Wins Checklist section
